notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R/W}.
Agrus Kos is not your commander.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}.
Cast Zealous Conscripts by paying {4}{R}.
Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Agrus Kos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Agrus Kos' ability, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Zealous Conscripts's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all copied abilities, untapping each creature you control and giving them haste.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}.
Repeat from step 4.
